entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You know, you look like a cat, but you[n]eat so much more than just fish.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That's because I'm not some mangy[n]stray. I'm a gourmet!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: So he says, but doesn't a gourmet have[n]a more... refined palate?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: He was chowin' down cat food the other[n]day, sayin' it was reeeal good.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Guess he just eats anythin' he can get[n]his paws on.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Perhaps cats are actually omnivores...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I'm right here, y'know!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: A fishing pond... Pondering what it must[n]contain is making me rather hungry.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: If you're so stressed about money, why[n]not try living on the fruit of the land?

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Oh, that's a good idea. You can just eat[n]what you catch here.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I did try that... I sat and waited for an[n]entire day, but was unable to catch a[n]single fish.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: In fact, after all the fees, I ended up in[n]the negative...

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: N-Negative? How much did you spend...?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: The equipment was the largest expense...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: As the day wore on, my eyes were drawn[n]to increasingly elegant rod and lure[n]designs. I had to rent them all.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: O-Oh, um... That's... fair, I guess?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Sometimes, calling an idiot an idiot is[n]the kindest thing you can do.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Fishing, huh... I could never get into it.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: You just sit there, waiting... It seems[n]so boring.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: That's exactly what's nice about it.[n]Sometimes, peace and quiet is just[n]what you need to relax your mind.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: I space out during class all the time, so[n]I think I'm good!

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: ...Mishima-kun. I'll be seeing you at the[n]student guidance room after this.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: What? You're telling me you trap these[n]creatures in a pool just so you can pull[n]them out again?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Well, uh, yeah. I guess that's it.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: And from what I hear, the way you pull[n]them is by tricking them into eating a[n]metal hook...

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: What is so enjoyable about this?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Argh, don't ask me! That's just how it is!

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: So they spend their mortal life on[n]activities they don't even enjoy...

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Humans are truly perplexing creatures.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: You know, these fish remind me of[n]that time Inari bought those lobsters.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: He said he got those for "visual[n]appreciation"... Do you think he's[n]still taking care of them?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Normally there'd be no way, but...[n]When it comes to Yusuke, it could[n]be a real possibility.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Maybe he gave them names! Like...[n]Gogh and Gauguin.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That's an even bigger possibility...
